title: Personal Credit Cards: Rewards Deposits Restoring an Overdrawn Autopay Account
content:
Among the ways a Personal Credit Cards cardholder may take rewards as cash, one serves a narrow purpose: putting money back into the checking account that a card draws its automatic payments from, when that account has fallen below zero.

## Scope and effect

The rule is engaged when the cardholder wants points applied against a card's debt while the PCB checking account the card has on record as its autopay source stands overdrawn. The card's points then go into that same checking account as a deposit, sized to bring it back up to zero, because a funding account in the red leaves the card's automatic payment with nothing to draw on.

## Where the deposit appears

Only the card carries a record of it. The redemption entry on the card shows which checking account the deposit was for and what it was worth in cash. The card rule makes no posting to that checking account's own ledger and takes no notice of whether one ever appears there.

## Running the redemption

Because the points are the cardholder's, the cardholder performs this redemption. The agent unlocks `restore_overdrawn_checking_with_points_4e4b44ef` on the customer side and passes it over, and the customer themselves runs it. Each run books a redemption entry on the card for the points supplied, notes the checking account and the cash value, and cuts the card's unredeemed points by that number straight away.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | the card whose points are redeemed, as the card account lookup returns it | identifier |
| `checking_account_id` | the cardholder's checking account that takes the deposit, as the checking account lookup returns it | identifier |
| `reward_points` | how many points are redeemed | whole positive integer, no decimal part |
| `amount` | cash value delivered | USD, positive, two decimals rounded half-up |

## What comes back

On success the reply carries `status` "redeemed", `card_txn_id`, `card_account_id`, `redemption_type` (always `deposit_to_checking`), `receiving_account_id` (the checking account the redemption entry names as receiving the deposit), `reward_points`, `amount`, `posted_date` and `new_rewards_balance`, the points still unredeemed on the card. The redemption is finished when that reply arrives.
